text:
mike: Quick note - during the weekend bootcamp the Next.js LangChain starter's eval harness failed repeatedly on Vercel edge. Minimal repro attached.

tara: Yep. Pattern: first request logs a 401, the SDK retries immediately, then we see 429. Local node target is fine.

nina: Is the sample using cookie-injected RW_API_KEY? We've seen header propagation races there.

mike: Yes, middleware sets cookie then edge API routes read it. Using @redwood/sdk-js@0.9.2.

ops-bot: CI | examples-smoke #768 failed: https://ci.internal/redwood/examples/768 - test log snippet included.

sophia: I added a tiny jittered backoff (30-100ms) in the harness before retrying and that stabilised the run in my repro.

tara: Also try setting keepAlive: false on the JS client. That reduced failures for me but didn't eliminate them.

nina: Can we add a preflight auth ping in example startup to warm the auth path? Might avoid the first-call race.

mike: Plan: update example README with 'Edge runtime troubleshooting' section + add auth ping + small backoff. I'll open a PR.

sophia: Filed SDK issue linking repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/4620. Includes curl traces and a failing test designed for the edge worker.

tara: For DX, we should tag the sample README with 'known-edge-quirk' and add a note in the bootcamp guide.

mike: Agreed. Follow-ups: PR for example + README, CI smoke deploy for example previews, triage SDK parity JS vs Python. Thanks everyone.
